unlisted_practices: Sequential screening using rule-based eTriggers followed by LLM adjudication to detect missed opportunities for diagnosis
Restricting expert human review to LLM-positive charts to reduce review time
LLM-generated case summaries for clinician-level feedback and quality improvement

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the performance and efficiency of an LLM used as a second-stage screening tool/adjudicator for identifying missed opportunities for diagnosis (MODs) in the emergency department, including reviewer time and utility of generated summaries.
